reference: Windows 10.0.19045, Intel i9-10900K, Node 24.9.0; desktop engineering qualification only
aggregation: Median of per-round percentiles from seven alternating fresh-process baseline/candidate pairs. No concurrent verification or profiling.

allocationGoal.method: Separate V8 allocation sampling, 16384-byte interval, include collected objects; same setup/warmup/observation included in both variants.

limits: Budgets apply to this named desktop reference, not Steam Deck/mobile certification or full-game FPS.
128 actors is a stress tier: the simulation can consume most of a 60 Hz frame at the baseline p99, before rendering.
Build edits comprise three previews and three publications; this synchronous burst is not a per-frame operation.
Device runners report measurements without silently applying desktop budgets on different hardware.
